summary: V50.z300 Fase 5 Area Corsi + 'Consigliato per te' fully verified. Backend edge cases (course_time normalization '9.30'→'09:30', invalid '25:99'→'', pre_reminders [1,7,99]→[7,1], put pre_reminders [0]→[0], recipient status='no' excluded from pre-reminder run, tour/recommendations dismiss 'zzz'→400, sub POST issue-all→403): 4/4 pytest passed against public URL. Frontend (390x844 web): login owner→tour-skip→Home shows testID 'home-recommended' with 5 cards (offline, courses, forms, deadlines, team) — tap 'home-recommended-courses' navigates to /courses ✅. /courses/new exposes testID course-time (Ora HH:MM) + chips course-pre-reminder-{7,3,1,0} (default 1 selected). Owner detail (/courses/<id>): '10:00' shown in header, '🔔 Promemoria prima della lezione' section with 4 chip toggles (chip 7 DOM-click toggled bg white→#7C3AED and persisted after reload). Issue-all button: initially disabled/grey (bg #F1F5F9, 0/0). Sub view (/courses/<id>): testID course-pre-reminder-hint visible with text '🔔 Riceverai un promemoria 1 giorno prima, il giorno stesso.'. Sub course-yes click via DOM turns green (rgb(5,150,105)). Owner re-open: issue-all becomes '(1/1)' with orange bg (rgb(217,119,6)); clicking triggers backend and body contains 'attestat' (auto cert already emitted since course has no test — second issue-all returns 0 new). Auth submit still requires DOM el.click() (not page.click) per iter90 note; same applies to pre-reminder Pressable chips and course-yes on this app's react-native-web build.

issues: Tap on 'Scegli' (course-recipients-pick) on web navigates the tab bar rather than opening an inline modal — cannot verify multi-select recipient picker via Playwright without native touch events. Not a blocker for testing (bypassed via API create), but flag for main agent that the pick modal may be dismissed by an ancestor touch handler on web.

action_items: Optional: investigate why 'Scegli' recipient picker on /courses/new drops to /contatti when interacted with on react-native-web (Escape key or overlay tap may propagate). Native/Expo Go likely OK.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/frontend/app/courses/[id].tsx togglePre() optimistically updates state before PUT — good UX; but on PUT failure it re-loads which may briefly flash the previous state. Consider a busy indicator on the chip while the PUT is in flight.

issue-all button in courses/[id].tsx uses c.yes_count==0 to disable; ensure disabled state also blocks tap on web (currently `disabled` attribute on Pressable-turned-div may still receive click events). Consider adding pointer-events:none inline when disabled.

success_rate.frontend: 100% critical flows validated (home card + tap → /courses, /courses/new fields, owner detail chips + issue-all, sub detail hint + course-yes)

context_for_next_testing_agent: IMPORTANT for this app on react-native-web: TouchableOpacity/Pressable-based buttons often DON'T fire onPress via Playwright page.click(force=True). Use DOM click: await page.evaluate("() => document.querySelector('[data-testid=\"X\"]').click()"). This is required for auth-submit-button, course-pre-reminder-*, course-yes, course-issue-all. On Home there are TWO copies of home-recommended in the DOM (react-native-web mount), use .last locator. Backend URL: https://business-card-pro-16.preview.emergentagent.com.
